name: Meeting Cancellation Reason 2 Code
definition: Specifies the reason for cancelling a meeting.

QORM.name: Quorum
QORM.definition: Cancellation due to insufficient participation to the vote.

PROC.name: Processing
PROC.definition: Cancellation due to a processing error.

WITH.name: Withdrawal
WITH.definition: Cancellation due to the meeting being cancelled by the issuer.
